title: Cross-Linguistic Distinctive-Feature Constraints on Segmental Triphones: Evidence for Contrastive Dispersion
abstract: arXiv:2611.26837v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural speech reflects articulatory and perceptual constraints, yet how these pressures shape consecutive segment transitions across languages remains underexplored. We analyze adjacent distinctive-feature distances in token-weighted segmental triphones across 17 Universal Dependencies corpora spanning nine language families, transcribed into IPA and mapped to 24 PanPhon features using Hamming and cosine metrics. Natural sequences exhibit an intermediate-distance mode (8-10 features under Hamming, except Vietnamese; 0.28-0.38 under cosine). Against an unrestricted within-word shuffled baseline, natural words reject the inventory-only null (W = 0, p < 10-4), showing higher expected distance, narrower dispersion, and lower joint triphone entropy in all 17 languages. translated_title: 跨语言区别特征对音段三元组的约束：对比离散度的证据
translated_abstract: 自然语音反映了发音与感知方面的约束，但这些约束如何塑造跨语言中连续音段之间的过渡仍缺乏充分研究。我们分析了来自17个Universal Dependencies语料库（涵盖九个语系）的、按词频加权的音段三元组中相邻区别特征的距离，语料经IPA转写并使用汉明距离和余弦距离两种度量映射到24个PanPhon特征。自然语音序列呈现中等距离的众数分布（汉明度量下为8-10个特征，越南语除外；余弦度量下为0.28-0.38）。相对于不受限制的词内打乱基线，自然词汇拒绝了仅基于音段库的零假设（W = 0，p < 10^-4），在全部17种语言中均表现出更高的期望距离、更窄的离散度和更低的三元组联合熵。在更严格的词内辅音-元音模板基线下，期望距离和离散度不再表现出分离，但联合熵在16种语言中仍然更低。
tldr: 该研究通过分析17种语言（涵盖九个语系）中音段三元组的区别特征距离，发现自然语音呈现中等特征距离模式，并相比随机基线展现出更窄的离散度和更低的联合熵，为跨语言的对比离散度约束提供了实证证据。
en_tdlr: Analyzing distinctive-feature distances in segmental triphones across 17 languages from nine language families, this study shows that natural speech exhibits an intermediate-distance mode with narrower dispersion and lower joint entropy than shuffled baselines, providing cross-linguistic evidence for contrastive dispersion constraints.
